title: AWS adds virtual iPhones to its cloud
extract: AWS has added virtual iPhones to its cloud device-testing service alongside Android emulation, but the initial catalogue is limited to two handsets and one tablet.

title: Initial AMD RDNA5 Support To Appear In Linux 7.5
extract: Initial AMD GFX13/RDNA5 enablement patches are being prepared for Linux 7.5, covering early graphics-controller, memory-controller and display support; the work remains experimental.

title: Omarchy 4.6-RC1 Released With More Local AI Integration, Its Own File Manager
extract: Omarchy 4.6-RC1 adds curated local-model selection, AI-agent Game Vibes and its own Qt6 file manager, plus in-house image, media and configuration tools.

title: Free e-government platform that serves two billion people in ten countries has critical SQL injection bug
extract: A critical SQL injection flaw in India's Digital Infrastructure for Governance Impact and Transformation platform could expose data across a public-service system used in ten countries and serving roughly two billion people.

title: 'Skins' for AmigaOS 3 window frames: SkinPatch 1.4
extract: SkinPatch 1.4 lets AmigaOS 3 users restyle Workbench window gadgets, title bars, frames and scrollbars with live-preview themes that apply without a reboot.

title: AmiSnip 1.3: Snipping Tool-style screen capture for AmigaOS 3
extract: AmiSnip 1.3 adds a selectable, resizable screen-capture area to AmigaOS 3, with options to copy the capture, save it to disk or open it directly in MultiView or PPaint.

title: PPC hardware: the next Mirari production run is due to start shortly
extract: The Mirari PowerPC mainboard has cleared component sourcing and its production order has been placed; assembly will be followed by CPU installation and U-Boot SD-card configuration.

title: Gamers, Your Wallet Might Lose the Battle to This New Arcade-Inspired Model from Alpina
extract: Alpina's Startimer Pilot Solarmetre gets a Galaga-inspired edition, bringing retro arcade styling to the brand's pilot-watch line.

title: It Looks Like AI Agent Skills Will Be Submitted For Linux 7.5
extract: Linux developer Sasha Levin plans to submit in-tree AI-agent skills for kernel workflows, including patch tagging, stable backports, bug-fix discovery, commit messages and KUnit tests.

title: Amid All The AI Generated Patches & Bug Reports, Linux Gains Another Network Maintainer
extract: Willem de Bruijn has been promoted to an additional mainline Linux networking maintainer, formally joining the subsystem's core maintainers after years maintaining networking components.

title: Microsoft: Hackers in China, N Korea using ARTEX AI tool to break into global tech systems
extract: Microsoft warns that China- and North Korea-linked attackers are using ARTEX, an agentic offensive framework that automates familiar intrusion techniques and can breach weak defenses rapidly.

title: One More Than GT40: The Ford GT41 Le Mans Hypercar Is Finally Here
extract: Ford has unveiled its 2027 Le Mans Hypercar, the GT41, with an in-house-developed naturally aspirated 5.4-litre V8 based on production engines; its final race livery will follow closer to the WEC season.

title: Ubuntu 27.04 Snapshot 1 Released For Testing
extract: Canonical has published the first monthly Ubuntu 27.04 'Tenacious T-Rex' snapshot for testing, providing an early development image ahead of the planned April 2027 release.

title: The Jaeger-LeCoultre Reverso Classic Monoface Small Seconds in a New Mid-Size Gold Case
extract: Jaeger-LeCoultre adds a mid-size 18k pink-gold case to the Reverso Classic Monoface Small Seconds, pairing 1931-inspired proportions with a hand-wound calibre 822 and a textured silver dial.

title: Linux 7.4 Delivers Some Performance Gains For Intel Panther Lake's Arc B390 Graphics
extract: Phoronix benchmarks show Linux 7.4 improving Intel Panther Lake Arc B390 graphics performance in several OpenGL and Vulkan tests, with gains varying by workload.

title: DXVK 3.2 Released With Present Timing Support
extract: DXVK 3.2 adds Vulkan present-timing support for steadier frame pacing in fullscreen games, alongside VRAM eviction, D3D11 upload improvements and game fixes.

title: Wyoming uranium operation shuts down after cyberattack
extract: Peninsula Energy says a cyberattack affected plant and wellfield control systems at its Wyoming uranium operation, forcing a shutdown with no restart date yet.

title: A Hands-On Introduction To The Twisted And Infinite Anoma A2
extract: Anoma's second wearable sculpture uses a twisted, Möbius-inspired stainless-steel case and a 4mm faceted sapphire crystal, with a hand-wound La Joux-Perret D101 movement and 50-hour power reserve.

title: Brush 0.5 Passing 96+% Of Upstream Test Suite For Bash Shell Written In Rust
extract: The Rust-written Bash/POSIX-compatible shell now passes more than 96% of the upstream bash-completion test suite, with over 3,600 end-to-end tests and improved pipelines, jobs and Windows binaries.

title: Microsoft hotpatches hotpatch that could crash Windows Server 2025
extract: Microsoft issued a corrective hotpatch for a Windows Server 2025 update that could crash systems when IPv6 routes expired; the correction does not require a restart.

title: Hackers help themselves to 1Password's source code and customer data
extract: 1Password says an intruder planted malicious code in backend services and accessed source code and customer data; the company says customer passwords remain safe.

title: 45°C inlets just killed the chiller. Most people haven't noticed yet
extract: A Supercomputing 2026 report examines how 45°C data-centre inlet-temperature designs could eliminate conventional chillers and reshape cooling infrastructure for high-density computing.

title: UK Home Office waved through border system without a working fix for bad data
extract: The ICO reprimanded the Home Office over its border data system, citing inaccurate records that risked wrongful detention and a temporary correction process that took more than a year to arrive.

title: UK & Ireland film cinema release dates: latest updates for 2026
extract: Screen Daily's updated UK and Ireland release calendar covers the 27 November cinema slate, including Disney's animated fantasy Hexed and other new genre releases.

title: Acura Integra Type S goes on sale in Japan from 18 December
extract: Acura's 320hp turbocharged Integra Type S reaches Japan on 18 December as the marque's first officially sold model there; it keeps the US-spec left-hand-drive layout and six-speed manual.

title: Mazda bosses: Beloved MX-5 is no longer essential to the brand
extract: Mazda UK executives say the MX-5 is less central to the brand than it once was, even as the fifth-generation roadster remains in development; the company still targets a sub-1,000kg car with a naturally aspirated petrol engine and manual option, while considering electrification.

title: Patrick Radden Keefe’s London Falling named Waterstones book of the year
extract: Keefe's investigation into the death of Zac Brettler wins Waterstones' overall Book of the Year; Yáng Shuāng-zǐ's Taiwan Travelogue takes fiction book of the year, while Is This a Plum? wins children's book of the year.

title: Huawei and crew tout homegrown EDA tools to overcome China’s fab deficit
extract: Huawei and partners are promoting homegrown electronic-design-automation tools focused on 3D packaging and multi-node chip assemblies as China works to overcome its semiconductor manufacturing constraints.

title: Microsoft's NTLM security changes trip up third-party logins
extract: Microsoft's tightened NTLM security changes are causing third-party login integrations to fail where implementations rely on older or incompatible authentication behavior.

title: Introducing the Hanhart 417 C Panna Flyback
extract: Worn & Wound introduces the 417 C Panna Flyback, a new vintage-inspired addition to Hanhart's historic pilot-chronograph line.

title: The Unimatic × Massena Lab Ghost Collection Explores The Effectiveness Of Monochromatic Camouflage
extract: The Ghost duo brings desert-sand and navy monochrome treatments to Unimatic's 36mm Modello Cinque, with 300m water resistance, Cerakote finishes and a protected Seiko VH31A quartz movement.

title: The Fox review – talking animals are the least weird thing in this delightfully peculiar comedy
extract: Dario Russo's offbeat Australian fantasy-comedy mixes Brothers Grimm fairytale strangeness with talking animals; Olivia Colman voices the fox and Sam Neill the magpie, with a UK and Ireland digital release set for 11 January.

title: PDF magazine: REV'n'GE 187 (Italian/English)
extract: Issue 187 of the retro-gaming magazine is available in English and Italian, comparing classic games across platforms and featuring Amiga reviews of Grand Slam and the Supra 28 Turbo accelerator.

title: Introducing Swatch Offers Winter Whimsy With The MoonSwatch Mission to Earthphase Silver Snowflake
extract: Swatch's latest limited MoonSwatch pairs a black Bioceramic case with a silver-engraved, individually unique snowflake on its patented Earthphase display; it goes on sale worldwide on 27 November.
